name: Hatsukoi Crash
source:
Kobayashi, a 27-year-old office lady who lives an ordinary life, is suddenly called by her first love, Nezu.

Kobayashi had some expectations for being reunited with her first love, but...!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/31915]Freem![/url]]
translation:
小林是一名27岁的白领，过着平凡的生活，突然接到初恋根津的电话。

小林原本对与初恋情人重逢抱有一些期待，但是……！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/31915]Freem![/url]]
